slashing_event_pending.meaning: a slashing event is about to occur
slashing_event_pending.checkpoint: before the slashing event is recorded

staked_amounts_large.meaning: staked amounts are sufficiently large that the cost of calling queueWithdrawal is lower than the penalty avoided

withdrawal_queued_before_slashing.meaning: user called queueWithdrawal on their funds just prior to the slashing event
withdrawal_queued_before_slashing.checkpoint: at the slashing event, after the withdrawal was queued

slashing_penalty_incurred.meaning: the user's funds incurred the slashing penalty associated with the slashing event
slashing_penalty_incurred.checkpoint: after the slashing event is applied

assumptions: The user holds staked funds in the protocol before the slashing event.
The slashing event applies a penalty to staked funds present at the time it is recorded.

unresolved.description: Report does not give a numeric definition of the penalty or of the cost of queueWithdrawal, so the 'cost lower than penalty avoided' comparison is represented only as the report-stated qualitative condition.
Report does not specify the exact timing window between queueWithdrawal and the slashing event beyond 'just prior'.

limitations: All scenarios are conditional/potential; no concrete amounts or transactions are given.
The relation is expressed with report-grounded Boolean observables because no numeric penalty or cost values are supplied.
